candidates.title: Sequoia: Scalable, Robust, and Hardware-aware Speculative Decoding
candidates.reason: hardware-aware tree optimizerを持つ投機的復号。A100で最大4.04倍、offload条件で大幅なdecode latency削減を報告し、推論高速化に直接関連。

candidates.title: SmoothQuant: Accurate and Efficient Post-Training Quantization for Large Language Models
candidates.reason: activation outlierをweight側へ移す等価変換でtraining-free W8A8量子化を実現し、最大1.56倍高速化・memory半減を報告。LLM推論量子化の基礎技術。
